grouping_rule: Within each category and region, sort unique OSM type/ID strings; add to the first existing cluster whose fixed anchor lies within 13 map-SVG units, otherwise start a cluster at this object. No transitive merging; zoom does not change membership. Former badge = member count. Counts are NOT capacity, severity or curb height.
current_display: No numeric badges. Curbs default off. Every group has an actual hover tooltip and a click/tap member list with source tags. Gates & barriers excludes barrier=kerb objects to avoid drawing the same curb through a second category. Crossings display removed, raw cache preserved.
interpretation: lowered/flush/raised/no/missing remain distinct raw evidence. No default impassability or obstacle score. Distinct OSM objects are not automatically distinct physical installations.
